title: Policy
description: Integrator-declared verification requirements for a single action. YAML policy files validate against this same schema after YAML-to-JSON conversion.

version.description: Policy DSL version. Currently only '1.0' is supported.

anchor_required.description: Whether the credential must include at least one anchor method.

min_supplementary_points.description: Minimum sum of supplementary method strengths required. Zero means no supplementary requirement.

allowed_methods.description: Restricts which method IDs may count toward the requirements. Omitted/null means all methods are allowed.

blocked_methods.description: Method IDs that must NOT count toward the requirements (overrides allowed_methods).

min_strength_per_method.description: Per-method minimum strength override. Tightens a method's requirement above its default registry value.

max_credential_age_seconds.description: Maximum age of the credential since its issuanceDate. Zero means no limit.

max_anchor_method_age_seconds.description: Maximum age of the anchor method verification since its verified_at timestamp. Zero means use the method's own freshness_lifetime.

require_fresh_anchor_proof.description: Require a live challenge-response proof of anchor control at presentation time.

nullifier_required.description: Require the credential to expose a NullifierBinding and present a derived nullifier scoped by nullifier_context_tag.

nullifier_context_tag.description: Per-context tag bound to the derived nullifier (e.g. 'vote:2026-05-24:proposal-42'). Required when nullifier_required is true.
